decision.reason: Even granting every unproven row as correct, precision can be no higher than 94.7836%, below the 95% release threshold.
required_policy: retain the original v1 rule artifact as historical evidence
publish this hash-bound independent audit beside it
apply none of the v1 entity-suffix or topic-keyword rules
exclude all v1 assertions from core graph and governed-model totals
do not change or reclassify independently audited v2 assertions

precision_assessment.method: Exhaustive conservative upper bound. Seven indisputable false-positive label populations were reviewed in every occurrence. Every other assertion, including ambiguous rows, is assumed true to maximize v1's possible precision.

reconstruction.method: Re-executed the literal title regex and topic-keyword sequence from source titles; compared canonical route/label and route/topic populations with the pre-rejection publication.
